Diagram gallery

Diagram gallery

At a glance

Architecture position
Generated gallery of every canonical vaft.diagram builder and its committed, TikZ-derived SVG assets.
Prerequisites / inputs
None to browse; latex and dvisvgm to render a diagram yourself.
Expected result
What each diagram looks like, the exact call that draws it, and which vaft.formula functions it is computed from.
Status
Maintained against the pinned develop baseline.

Generated from vaft.diagram.build.CANONICAL and docs/assets/diagrams/manifest.json by python -m vaft.diagram.docs_catalog: 192 builders, 242 committed SVGs. Nothing on this page is written by hand.

Each picture is the committed SVG rendered from the builder’s TikZ source; the caption is the exact call that produced it, so vaft.diagram.<call>.save("x.svg") reproduces it. What the diagrams mean, and the conventions they share, is explained on Scientific diagrams. python -m vaft.diagram.build --check verifies that every SVG here still matches its source.
